name: Improved HP Recovery
description:
[Master Level: 15]
HP naturally regenerates over time, not just when standing still. Also, HP recovery from items is boosted.

name: Max HP Increase
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Max HP increases.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Improved HP Recovery

name: Precise Strikes
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Repeated practice with your weapon has increased your Accuracy and Critical Rate.

name: Iron Body
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily increases your Weapon Defense.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Max HP Increase

name: Power Strike
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to deliver a lethal blow to a single enemy with your weapon.

name: Slash Blast
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to attack up to 6 enemies around you with your weapon.
Required Skill: At least Level 1 Power Strike

name: Sword Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Sword Mastery and Accuracy. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.

name: Axe Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Axe Mastery, and attacks have a chance to inflict a bleeding effect on the target when attacking. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed axe is equipped.

name: Final Attack: Sword
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to up to 3 enemies in front. Only applies when equipped with a one-handed or two-handed sword.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Sword Mastery

name: Final Attack: Axe
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to up to 3 enemies in front. Only applies when equipped with a one-handed or two-handed axe.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Axe Mastery

name: Sword Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped sword. Only applies when equipped with a one-handed or two-handed sword.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Sword Mastery

name: Axe Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped axe. Only applies when equipped with a one-handed or two-handed axe.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Axe Mastery

name: Rage
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Temporarily increases the Attack Power of everyone in the party around the area, but also decreases Weapon Def.

name: Rush
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 6 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.
Cooldown: 2 sec

Increases Sword Mastery and Accuracy. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed sword is equipped.

name: Blunt Weapon Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Blunt Weapon Mastery and Critical Damage. It only applies when a one-handed or two-handed blunt weapon is equipped.

Required Skill: At least Level 3 Blunt Weapon Mastery

Required Skill: At least Level 5 Sword Mastery

name: Blunt Weapon Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped blunt weapon. Only applies when equipped with a one-handed or two-handed blunt weapon.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Blunt Weapon Mastery

name: Threaten
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Use MP to temporarily threaten monsters. Decreases the Movement Speed and Weapon Def. of up to 4 monsters around the area.

name: Rush
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 6 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.
Cooldown: 2 sec

name: Spear Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Spear Mastery and gives a chance to deal damage that ignores the target’s Weapon Def. It only applies when a spear is equipped.

name: Polearm Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Polearm Mastery and movement speed. It only applies when a polearm is equipped.

name: Final Attack: Spear
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy and absorbing some of the damage dealt as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy. Only applies when equipped with a spear.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Spear Mastery

name: Final Attack: Polearm
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy and absorbing some of the damage dealt as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy. Only applies when equipped with a polearm.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Polearm Mastery

name: Spear Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped spear. Only applies when equipped with a spear.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Spear Mastery

name: Polearm Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped polearm. Only applies when equipped with a polearm.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Polearm Mastery

name: Iron Will
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Temporarily increases the user's Weapon Defense and grants a chance to ignore knockback effects.

name: Rush
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 6 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.
Cooldown: 2 sec

name: Improved MP Recovery
description:
[Master Level: 15]
The amount of MP that naturally regenerates over time increases. Also, MP recovery from items is boosted.

name: Max MP Increase
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Max MP increases.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Improved MP Recovery

name: Magic Guard
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Replaces a portion of damage taken with MP instead of HP. If MP reaches 0, all damage is taken as HP. Press the key again to deactivate the effect.

name: Magic Armor
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily increases Weapon Def. and Magic Def. by concentrating magic into your armor.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Magic Guard

name: Energy Bolt
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to attack a single enemy within 350 range in front. The higher the Mastery, the lower the damage variation.

name: Magic Claw
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to attack a single enemy within 300 range in front twice. The higher the Mastery, the lower the damage variation.
Required Skill: At least Level 1 Energy Bolt

name: MP Eater
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Absorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy's MP is 0.

name: Meditation
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Meditate for a bit to temporarily increase the Magic Attack of party members around the area.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 MP Eater

name: Teleport
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Use the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.

name: Slow
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily slows down the movement speed and evasion of up to 6 monsters. Cannot be used on monsters that are already affected.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Teleport

name: Fire Arrow
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Fires a fire arrow created with magic power at a single enemy, dealing fire-elemental damage and burning them to inflict continuous damage every second for 3 seconds. Deals increased damage to fire-weak enemies, but deals reduced damage to fire-resistant enemies and cannot burn them.

name: Poison Breath
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Fires a poison droplet at a single enemy. The droplet explodes on contact, dealing poison-elemental damage to up to 6 nearby enemies and granting a chance to poison them. Deals increased damage to poison-weak enemies, but deals reduced damage to poison-resistant enemies and cannot poison them.

source.notes: Hidden skill with no name in the client files.

name: Cold Beam
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Attacks a single enemy with a sharp piece of ice, dealing ice-elemental damage. Enemies hit are briefly frozen, slowing their actions. Deals increased damage to ice-weak enemies, but deals reduced damage to ice-resistant enemies and cannot slow them.

name: Thunder Bolt
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Attacks surrounding monsters with a thunderbolt, dealing lightning-elemental damage. All monsters, except those resistant to lightning, have a chance to be stunned by electrocution.

name: MP Eater
description:
[Master Level: 20]

name: Teleport
description:

name: Heal
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Recovers the HP of all party members around the area. The amount of healing depends on the number of people being healed, and undead monsters around the area will receive damage.

name: Invincible
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Reduces physical damage taken for a certain duration, and deals non-elemental magic damage to any monster that takes contact damage from the caster.
Required Skill : At least Level 5 Heal

name: Bless
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily reduces all Damage taken and increases the HP recovery from the Heal skill for all nearby party members.
Required Skill : At least Level 5 Invincible

name: Holy Arrow
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Attacks a monster by firing a holy arrow. Very effective against the undead or devil-based monsters.

name: Critical Shot
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

name: The Eye of Amazon
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Increases attack range for bows and crossbows.

name: Focus
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Focus to temporarily increase Accuracy and Evasion.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 The Eye of Amazon

name: Arrow Blow
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Fires an arrow with power at a single enemy within 350 range in front. Deals more damage than usual.

name: Double Shot
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes 2 arrows to attack up to 2 enemies within 300 range in front.
Required Skill: At least Level 1 Arrow Blow

name: Power Knockback
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Swings the bow widely to push multiple enemies far back. This attack always hits as a critical, and as the level rises, the number of monsters that one can push back with one swing increases.

name: Bow Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Bow Mastery, Critical Rate, and Movement Speed. This effect only applies when a bow is equipped.

name: Amazon's Judgement
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Critical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down.
Required Skill : At least Level 5 Bow Mastery

name: Final Attack: Bow
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Using attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to up to 3 enemies in front. Only applies when equipped with a bow.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Bow Mastery

name: Bow Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped bow. Only applies when equipped with a bow.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Bow Mastery

name: Soul Arrow: Bow
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily allows the character to fire bow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a bow equipped.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Bow Booster

name: Arrow Bomb
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Fires an arrow with a bomb attached to it. If struck cleanly, the bomb explodes on the enemy, stunning some enemies around with a certain trigger rate. Can't attack more than 6 at once, and it only works with a bow equipped.

source.notes: Hidden skill with no name in the client files.

name: Crossbow Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Crossbow Mastery and Critical Damage. It only applies when a crossbow is equipped.

Required Skill : At least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery

name: Final Attack: Crossbow

Required Skill: At least Level 3 Crossbow Mastery

name: Crossbow Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped crossbow. Only applies when equipped with a crossbow.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery

name: Soul Arrow: Crossbow
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily allows the character to fire crossbow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a crossbow equipped.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Crossbow Booster

name: Iron Arrow
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Attacks up to 6 monsters at once with a powerful arrow, which penetrates through them. Damage decreases as the arrow flies through each monster.

name: Nimble Body
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Increases Accuracy and Evasion.

name: Keen Eyes
description:
[Master Level: 15]
Increases attack range for throwing weapons such as Throwing Stars and Knives.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 on Nimble Body

name: Disorder
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily decreases the Attack Power and Weapon Def. of an enemy and dissuades it from attacking you. Has no effect on a monster that's already in "Disorder."

name: Dark Sight
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to hide in the shadows. Cannot be attacked and cannot attack while hidden. Press the key again to deactivate the effect.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Disorder

name: Double Stab
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to quickly stab a monster twice using a dagger.

name: Lucky Seven
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes MP to throw 2 throwing stars at a single enemy within 200 range in front, dealing powerful damage based on LUK. Attacks based on LUK regardless of Claw Mastery.

name: Claw Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Claw Mastery and Attack Power, and gives a chance to recover used throwing stars when using throwing star attacks. Only applies when a claw is equipped.

name: Critical Throw
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Required Skill: At least Level 3 Claw Mastery

name: Critical Recovery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Recovers additional HP and MP with a certain chance when landing a critical hit. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.

name: Claw Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped claw. Only applies when equipped with a claw.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Claw Mastery

name: Haste
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.

name: Drain
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Absorbs some of the damage dealt to the enemy as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy.
Required Skill : At least Level 3 Critical Recovery

name: Dagger Mastery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Dagger Mastery and Critical Rate, with a chance to ignore knockback effects. It only applies when a dagger is equipped.

name: Nimble Recovery
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Recover HP and MP with a certain chance when evading. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.

name: Dagger Booster
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Consumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped dagger. Only applies when equipped with a dagger.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Dagger Mastery

name: Haste
description:
[Master Level: 20]
Temporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.

name: Steal
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Attempts to steal an item from up to 2 monsters at once with a given success rate. On a successful steal, stuns the enemies for 1.5 seconds and increases Attack Power for 60 seconds. Stealing works only once per monster and can be attempted until successful.
Required Skill: At least Level 5 Haste

name: Savage Blow
description:
[Master Level: 30]
Use MP to attack an enemy up to 6 times in a row with a dagger.
